data.long_meaning: Muslihah is a name derived from the Arabic root 's-l-h', which means 'to reconcile', 'to make right', or 'to set things in order'. This name is often used in the context of mending relationships, seeking forgiveness, and striving for peace and harmony. The name Muslihah carries the meaning “Reconcile, Set Right” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Muslihah usually hope their child will grow to embody reconcile, set right and live with faith, good character and purpose.
